theorems.name: Submission.bv_exists_subseq_tendsto_lintegral_of_finite_nets
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (Q : ℕ → Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), (∀ j k, IntegrableOn (u k) (Q j) volume) → (∀ j, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ F : Finset ℕ, ∀ k, ∃ i ∈ F, (∫⁻ x in Q j, ‖u k x - u i x‖ₑ) < ENNReal.ofReal ε) → ∃ (ψ : ℕ → ℕ) (G : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), StrictMono ψ ∧ (∀ j, IntegrableOn (G j) (Q j) volume) ∧ ∀ j, Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫⁻ x in Q j, ‖u (ψ k) x - G j x‖ₑ) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
